nodes.name: full_handcrafting.py
nodes.summary: Self-contained reference implementation of Rob Carver's full 'handcrafting' portfolio optimisation method, building hierarchical sub-portfolios via correlation clustering and assigning risk-target-adjusted weights with Sharpe-ratio uncertainty corrections. Explicitly a standalone teaching version, not the code wired into the live system.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy numpy/pandas/scipy use: Fisher-transform correlation confidence intervals, hierarchical clustering (scipy.cluster.hierarchy), bootstrap SR-difference simulation, and constrained optimisation via scipy.optimize.minimize.

nodes.name: Portfolio
nodes.summary: Core recursive handcrafting object that partitions instruments into correlation-clustered sub-portfolios, then computes volatility weights, cash weights, diversification multipliers and risk-target-scaled allocations across the resulting tree.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses recursive composition of child Portfolio objects plus cached_property-style accessor methods exposing volatility/cash weights and portfolio returns.

nodes.name: diagobject
nodes.summary: Lightweight diagnostics container used to attach intermediate handcrafting calculation outputs for inspection and printing.

nodes.name: get_weights_using_uncertainty_method
nodes.summary: Entry point for correlation-uncertainty-aware weighting: for small asset counts derives weights accounting for correlation estimation error, otherwise falls back to equal weights with a warning.

nodes.name: optimised_weights_given_correlation_uncertainty
nodes.summary: Computes average optimal weights across many sampled correlation matrices drawn from confidence intervals, capturing weight sensitivity to correlation estimation uncertainty.

nodes.name: optimise_for_corr_matrix_with_uncertainty
nodes.summary: Samples a correlation matrix from its confidence-interval distribution and returns the minimum-weighted optimal portfolio weights for that draw.

nodes.name: calculate_correlation_points_from_tuples
nodes.summary: Maps each labelled pairwise correlation to a confidence-interval point estimate using the Fisher-transform distribution given the number of data points.

nodes.name: get_fisher_confidence_point
nodes.summary: Returns a correlation value shifted to a given confidence-interval percentile in Fisher-transformed space, used to bound correlation estimation error.

nodes.name: three_asset_corr_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds a 3x3 correlation matrix from three labelled pairwise correlations for the canonical three-asset handcrafting building block.

nodes.name: mini_bootstrap_ratio_given_SR_diff
nodes.summary: Runs a small bootstrap simulation to estimate the relative weight ratio between assets given a Sharpe-ratio difference, average correlation, and data length, smoothing out estimation noise.

nodes.name: weights_given_SR_diff
nodes.summary: Derives two-asset relative weights from a Sharpe-ratio difference and average correlation, choosing analytic or bootstrap estimation depending on confidence inputs.

nodes.name: boring_corr_matrix
nodes.summary: Constructs a simple correlation matrix with a constant off-diagonal correlation and unit diagonal of a given size, used as a default/placeholder correlation structure.

nodes.name: adjust_weights_for_SR
nodes.summary: Rescales a set of portfolio weights to account for differing Sharpe ratios across assets, adjusting allocations toward higher-SR instruments given correlation and data length.

nodes.name: how_many_years_of_data_in_pd_series
nodes.summary: Estimates the span of a pandas Series in years from its index range, used to weight correlation/Sharpe confidence by available history.

nodes.name: get_avg_corr
nodes.summary: Computes the average off-diagonal pairwise correlation from a covariance/correlation matrix, used as a summary input to handcrafting weight calculations.

nodes.name: cluster_correlation_matrix
nodes.summary: Partitions instruments into clusters of a maximum size from their correlation matrix using hierarchical clustering, forming the sub-portfolio tree.

nodes.name: optimise
nodes.summary: Performs constrained mean-variance optimisation via scipy.optimize.minimize over a fixed covariance matrix and mean vector, returning fully-invested long-only weights that minimise negative Sharpe ratio.

nodes.name: fix_sigma
nodes.summary: Sanitises a covariance matrix for optimisation by replacing invalid/NaN entries, ensuring scipy.optimize receives a well-formed positive matrix.

nodes.name: un_fix_weights
nodes.summary: Re-expands an optimised weight vector back over the original asset set, re-inserting zero weights for assets excluded during the optimisation fix-up step.
